outcome: Give Consulting / SI teams a working Legacy Code & Data Migration Modernization Accelerator capability on their own data — it reduces migration timelines by months and manual refactoring effort.
overview: Modernisation programmes overrun because the legacy estate is undocumented: dependencies surface mid-flight, effort cannot be priced honestly, and a thin test suite turns cutover into a gamble. This accelerator indexes the existing codebase and schemas, maps what actually depends on what, proposes a refactoring path, and generates target-service scaffolding plus the migration tests that make a parallel run meaningful. Senior engineers approve every change; the accelerator drafts, it never merges. A five-to-six week build on one real application shows the shape of the whole programme: a defensible timeline, a smaller manual refactoring load, and cutover evidence a client steering committee will accept.
